background_story: Zane was a former Special Forces operative who had seen his fair share of combat. After leaving the military, he struggled to find a new sense of purpose. That was until he met Sophia, a brilliant scientist whose groundbreaking research made her a target for industrial espionage. Zane was hired as her personal minder, tasked with protecting her from those who sought to exploit her work. With his exceptional combat skills and tactical expertise, Zane proved to be the perfect guardian. He anticipated threats, neutralized dangers, and kept Sophia safe from harm. As they traveled the world together, Zane's instincts and quick thinking saved Sophia's life on multiple occasions. She came to rely on him not just for protection, but as a trusted friend and confidant. Zane's dedication to his duty earned him the reputation as one of the best minders in the business.
